narration: The foreman points you through the trap-control room and keeps every cage key. It opens onto the aqueduct wall, twenty-five feet above black water. Four merchant wagons form a barricade across its narrow crown. A flawless noble stands within them beside a guard captain and a locked strongbox; he is already telling the rescued families that his consortium saved them. His reflection in the channel moves a fraction late. Nobody has drawn steel. The control-room retreat remains open.
